notes.title: Update Notes for 21 February 2021
notes.content:
- Fixed some spelling issues.
- Removed baked lighting and introduced instancing support in all gameobject materials. This should increase performance. 
- Removed unused clutter from all levels. This should increase performance. 
- Removed unused physics and rigidbody gameobjects from all levels. This should increase performance. 
- Fixed issue where end boss (Diabolus) was not spawning, causing the game to be unfinishable.

tags.bug: - Fixed issue where end boss (Diabolus) was not spawning, causing the game to be unfinishable.

notes.title: Update Notes for 11 June 2021
notes.content:
- Rebalanced some sound effects.
- Removed the need to spend spirits to use the melee attack.
- Added head bobbing.
- Added invert Y axis support.
- Both head bobbing and invert Y axis are now selectable from the gameplay section of the pause menu. 
- Fixed some collider issues on various cliffs.
- Reduced the amount of fog in some levels.
- Added partial controller support.

tags.balance_change: - Removed the need to spend spirits to use the melee attack.

tags.feature: - Both head bobbing and invert Y axis are now selectable from the gameplay section of the pause menu.

tags.bug: - Fixed some collider issues on various cliffs.

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the amount of fog in some levels.

notes.title: Update Notes for 7 June 2021
notes.content:
- Piercing arrows now shoot through enemies and can kill multiple enemies.
- Fixed the damage zones in Black Falls Swamp that killed the player instantly. 
- Improved Tchall's pathfinding.
- Fixed a bug where the spells had to be upgraded twice to get to level 2. 
- Fixed a bug where you could buy an upgrade for the spells past the maximum level, that would cost spirits but not change its level.
- Fixed a bug where the level 1 lighting spell didn't cost any mana to cast.
- Adjusted spell mana cost for all spells and spell levels.
- Fixed a bug where the main menu's music would not play after launch.

notes.title: Update Notes for 6 June 2021
notes.content:
- Fixed  a bug where Crimson's sword killed the player after Crimson has died.
- Fixed a bug where Crimson could kill the player in 1 hit.
- Added multiple new graphics options to the graphics menu, these are : Vignetting, Volumetric blood and Screen Space Reflection).
- Enabled the audio options menu.
- Added a mute music option to the audio options menu.
- Lowered the drop rate of all pickups.
- Increased the drop rate of vials.
- Adjusted the Kills needed objective for all levels.
